# Casper guides

> Guides written for this repository on what the official Casper documentation does not cover yet. Every factual sentence links its source: a release tag or a commit where one exists, otherwise the page, file or live response it came from, with the date it was read. Each guide names what it was verified against on its third line, and a weekly check flags a guide when that source moves.

Each link fetches the page's raw markdown; the URL after the colon is where it is published.
Generated by https://github.com/msanlisavas/casper-llms from its guides folder.
